name: Creamed Salmon
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: Salt and cayenne pepper to taste
ingredients.originalText: Salt and cayenne pepper to taste

instructions.text: Take a tin of salmon, empty on a dish and flake with a fork
Have ready a sauce made in double boiler from one pint of milk, butter size of an egg, one teaspoonful of flour, with salt and cayenne pepper to taste
Melt butter and flour until smooth and add milk slowly
When it boils remove from fire and add two well-beaten eggs
Put alternate layers of salmon and sauce in baking dish until all is used
Cover with layer of cracker or bread-crumbs
Bake fifteen minutes and serve hot

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take a tin of salmon, empty on a dish and flake with a fork
2. Have ready a sauce made in double boiler from one pint of milk, butter size of an egg, one teaspoonful of flour, with salt and cayenne pepper to taste
3. Melt butter and flour until smooth and add milk slowly
4. When it boils remove from fire and add two well-beaten eggs
5. Put alternate layers of salmon and sauce in baking dish until all is used
6. Cover with layer of cracker or bread-crumbs
7. Bake fifteen minutes and serve hot
